title: Conformal Expert Pools: Training-Free Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting Beyond Seasonality
abstract: arXiv:2611.21267v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP) showed that a forecaster with no training at all, built only from past values at the same point in the season and from past forecast errors, significantly outperformed DeepNPTS, Amazon's learned non-parametric forecaster. We propose Conformal Expert Pools (CEP), a training-free successor. CEP replaces the single seasonal-naive forecast by a pool of simple forecasters, builds its predictive distribution from their past forecast errors, and adapts both the pool and the errors to the series being forecast. No model is trained and no parameter is learned across series. On the CSP benchmark of 232 datasets and 24,502 forecast windows, CEP is better than CSP on 78% of datasets by CRPS, on 84% by MSIS and on 83% by Winkler score; on a typical dataset its CRPS is 14% lower and its MSIS 23% lower (both p < 1e-22, paired Wilcoxon test), and coverage of 95% intervals rises from 90.1% to 92.2%. translated_title: 共形专家池：超越季节性的免训练概率时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 共形季节池表明，一个完全无需训练的预测器，仅基于季节中同一位置的历史数值和历史预测误差构建，其性能显著超过了亚马逊基于学习的非参数预测器DeepNPTS。我们提出了共形专家池（CEP），作为其免训练的后继方法。CEP用一组简单预测器池替代单一的季节朴素预测，根据这些预测器的历史预测误差构建预测分布，并针对被预测的序列对预测器池和误差进行自适应调整。该方法无需训练任何模型，也不跨序列学习任何参数。在包含232个数据集和24,502个预测窗口的CSP基准测试中，CEP在78%的数据集上CRPS优于CSP，在84%的数据集上MSIS更优，在83%的数据集上Winkler评分更优；在典型数据集上，其CRPS降低14%，MSIS降低23%（两者p < 1e-22，配对Wilcoxon检验），且95%预测区间的覆盖率从90.1%提升至92.2%。CEP具有更低的CRPS……
tldr: 提出免训练的概率预测方法共形专家池（CEP），通过简单预测器池及其历史误差自适应构建预测分布，在232个数据集基准上全面超越CSP，典型数据集CRPS降低14%、MSIS降低23%。
en_tdlr: Conformal Expert Pools (CEP) is a training-free probabilistic time-series forecasting method that adaptively builds predictive distributions from a pool of simple forecasters and their past errors, outperforming CSP on 232 datasets with 14% lower CRPS and 23% lower MSIS.
